import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentAffine
import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleBaseChange

/-!
# Base change for restriction of quasicoherent sections

On a basic open of an affine spectrum, the actual section restriction of a
quasicoherent sheaf realizes extension of scalars to the basic-open section
ring. This is the local restriction input for affine-overlap module descent.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib

variable {R : CommRingCat.{u}}

/-- Section restriction on an affine spectrum, linear over its coordinate ring. -/
noncomputable def affineSectionsRestrictionMap (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    {U V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ≤ U) : Γ(F, U) →ₗ[R] Γ(F, V) :=
  ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj F).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom

/-- The coordinate-ring action on global sections is the action through the
canonical identification with the global section ring. -/
theorem coordinateRing_smul_eq_globalSections_smul (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    (r : R) (m : Γ(F, ⊤)) :
    r • m = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r • m := by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
  change ((Spec R).presheaf.map (𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))))
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r) • m = _
  simp

/-- The affine restriction map also respects the full section-ring actions,
with coefficients restricted along the same open inclusion. -/
theorem affineSectionsRestrictionMap_smul (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    {U V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (r : Γ(Spec R, U)) (m : Γ(F, U)) :
    affineSectionsRestrictionMap F h (r • m) =
      (Spec R).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r • affineSectionsRestrictionMap F h m :=
  F.map_smul (homOfLE h) r m

/-- Ordinary restriction of affine quasicoherent sections is base change to
the actual section ring of a basic open. -/
theorem quasicoherent_basicOpenRestriction_isBaseChange
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R) :
    IsBaseChange Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      (affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)) := by
  letI : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
      (affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)) :=
    qcoh_section_isLocalizedModule F f
  exact IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange (Submonoid.powers f)
    Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) _

/-- The tensor comparison sends a pure tensor to multiplication of the
restricted section by its coefficient on the basic open. -/
noncomputable def quasicoherentBasicOpenRestrictionEquiv
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R) :
    Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ⊗[R] Γ(F, ⊤)
      ≃ₗ[Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)] Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
  (quasicoherent_basicOpenRestriction_isBaseChange F f).equiv

@[simp]
theorem quasicoherentBasicOpenRestrictionEquiv_tmul
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R)
    (a : Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)) (m : Γ(F, ⊤)) :
    quasicoherentBasicOpenRestrictionEquiv F f (a ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      a • affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤) m :=
  IsBaseChange.equiv_tmul _ _ _

/-- The ordinary module comparison used in invariant-module descent is
bijective for the actual restriction to a basic open. -/
theorem quasicoherent_basicOpenRestriction_moduleBaseChangeMap_bijective
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R) :
    Function.Bijective (GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) Γ(F, ⊤) Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      (affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤))) := by
  have heq : GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      R Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) Γ(F, ⊤) Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      (affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)) =
        (quasicoherentBasicOpenRestrictionEquiv F f).toLinearMap := by
    ext a
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact (quasicoherentBasicOpenRestrictionEquiv F f).bijective

end MilneLib
